title: Turn a cart total into signal and computed
summary: The total is recalculated by hand after each action, and remove forgets to. items becomes a signal and total a computed.

turns.user: pressing - in the cart doesnt lower the total. + works

assistant.body: You're right, remove never calls recalc. Adding the call would fix it today, but the next action someone adds can forget it the same way. Let's make items a signal and derive total from it with computed. items becomes the single source of truth for the total, so a forgotten recalc can no longer happen. Signals are read by calling them, so the template reads items() and total().

turns.user: ok. also want shipping, free at 3000 or more, 500 otherwise. under the total. oh and the total with shipping too

assistant.body: Sure. A computed can read another computed. shipping derives from total, and grandTotal from total and shipping. Dependencies are tracked from whatever signals get read, so nothing has to trigger a recalculation. Two fields go under total, and two lines go into the template.

shipping = computed(() => (this.total() >= 3000 ? 0 : 500))
  grandTotal = computed(() => this.total() + this.shipping())

sed -i '' '/

Total: {{ total() }}<\/p>/a\

Shipping: {{ shipping() }}

\

Grand total: {{ grandTotal() }}

' src/app/cart.component.ts
